method: Session B: the 110 shortlisted frames at 1400px, 100% crops for every frame at 3★ or more (second spots on 4262, 4361, 4548, 4143, 4261, 4465), then the 21 held frames side by side with their scene's best at 1000px; held frames carry "held": true, and 4315, which changed its scene, "pulled": true. "cull" is Mihail's Lightroom star from the export's XMP rating. 4470 checked against the site's fives. 3646 (St Joseph's, 29 Oct) is rated in beijing-25.ratings.json.

frames.technical: Clean; the sunlit needles at the top are bright but hold
frames.critique: The pines do the work: their trunks twist up in S-curves and the backlit autumn needles close the top like a roof, so the grove reads as a room. The tai chi figures sit in one loose band across the middle with their arms out, a gesture that reads even small. But the lower 40% is shadowed paving that the dappled light only half-fills, and the raised hand cut at the right edge pulls the eye out. A morning-in-the-park frame with real life in it, not more.
frames.focus: sharp (the paving and bench at 100%); the walker crossing at the right is motion-soft, the tai chi group sharp at display size

frames.technical: Clean; sky a flat deep blue
frames.critique: From the Mound down to the lingxing gates and the Imperial Vault behind. Everything is the same distance and the same weight: the gates, the crowd between them and the balustrade in front stack into one busy band, with blank sky over 40% of the frame and the vault too small to be the point. The lion pillar and the people cut at the right edge are the nearest and brightest things. A record of the axis.

frames.technical: Clean; sky smooth, no dust seen at this size
frames.critique: The two red walls bend round the empty terrace in concentric arcs, and that curve is the frame's line: it carries the eye across and out to the CITIC tower rising alone above the trees, the temple and the business district in one view. The tiny walkers on the terrace give the scale. What holds it back is the edges: the balustrade's cut lion post on the left and a crowd at the bottom right, both nearer and brighter than the walkers, and a top third of plain sky. A good idea, three-quarters executed.
frames.focus: sharp (the CITIC tower and the trees, 100%)

frames.technical: Verticals straight; the white marble holds against the deep sky
frames.critique: A strong graphic shape: the lingxing gate stands square against a deep blue sky, its cloud-scroll ornaments cut out cleanly, and its opening frames the stair up to the Circular Mound with the crowd on its rings. The young man stepping through gives the opening a moment. The bottom third is plain paving with a shadow creeping in, which makes the frame bottom-heavy; a 4:5 crop from the bottom would help. Frame-within-frame, but the gate is also simply a good shape in good light.
frames.focus: sharp (the young man in the opening, 100%)

frames.technical: Square crop; clean sky, no dust seen; level
frames.critique: Built in horizontal bands: plain paving, the long red wall with its blue tile cap, the three gate arches and the Imperial Vault's cone, then sky. The one woman at the wall gives the red band its scale and a reason to look along it. Mid-morning side light picks out the glazed tiles and the arches' red doors. But the bands are evenly weighted: paving and sky each take a third and say nothing, and the lamp post with its CCTV globes sits right against the vault's roof. Calm and well-lit; a 3 that could be cropped to 16:9 round the wall and the roofs.
frames.focus: sharp (the vault's tiles and the gate's red doors, 100%)

frames.technical: Shallow focus by design: sharpness on the second roundel, falling off both ways; to check at 100%
frames.critique: A diagonal row of cobalt tile-ends, each with a dragon in relief, running from the near corner away into soft focus. The repetition and the shrinking roundels give it depth, the hard sun picks out the glaze and the chipped edges, and the blue against the warm red wall and the dark trees is the Temple of Heaven's colour in one detail. The near left roundel cut by the edge is a little heavy. The detail the place is made of, done with intent.
frames.focus: soft-intended (the second roundel's dragon and crazed glaze sharp; the rest falls off by design); second spot on the near roundel soft, as intended

frames.technical: Low angle; the sky is pale and near white at the top; slight flare on the right eave
frames.critique: Two gate roofs lean in towards each other from below, and the gap of sky between them makes a jagged diagonal; the third, lower roof closes it at the bottom. The painted brackets in green, blue and gold are rich, and the right eave is rim-lit by the sun behind it. It's an abstract of shapes, but the grey brick takes up the whole bottom and sides, and the sky is pale, so the colour sits in two narrow bands. A good eye for the shape; the light is against it.

frames.technical: Verticals held; clean deep sky
frames.critique: The Imperial Vault square-on, its blue cone and gold finial against a deep sky, with the red lanterns stepping towards the lens on the right. The lanterns are a good near layer and lead the eye up the right side. But the frame splits: the hall is a centred record in the top two-thirds, and the bottom third is people milling at both edges, the nearest lantern cut at the bottom. Strong colour in good light, a documentary composition.
frames.focus: sharp (the phoenix frieze and the lattice, 100%)

frames.technical: Clean deep sky, no dust seen; verticals fine for a low angle
frames.critique: Close and low, the Imperial Vault's cone sweeps out of the top left and its eave arcs across to the right, so the frame is one big curve against a deep blue that takes the right half. The small red burner at the bottom right repeats the cone in miniature and in the opposite colour: the rhyme is what makes it more than a detail of a famous roof. The hard late-morning sun renders every colour band under the eave. The hall cut at the left edge is the right call. Nothing wasted.

frames.technical: Clean; the shadow side of the arch holds detail
frames.critique: The subject is the shadow: the gate's scalloped arch throws its own outline onto the red door, so the arch appears twice, in stone and in shade, and the gold studs run in rows through both. That's a found graphic, not a record of a door. The girl crouching at the railing with her tripod gives the size and a small private moment; her face is hidden. The crowd barrier across the bottom third is the cost: it's in the way of the door, though its shadows on the ground echo the bars. Strong, slightly fenced in.

frames.technical: Shade on the beam holds detail; the hall slightly warm; bright Nike logo on the backpack at the bottom right
frames.critique: The Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests seen through the gate: the painted beam and the column frame it, dark and richly patterned, and the hall sits lit in the opening against deep blue. Below, the crowd raises its phones towards it, which is the frame's point as much as the hall: this is how the place is met on a holiday weekend. The heads take the bottom third and the pale backpack at the bottom right is the brightest near thing, which pulls the eye. A frame on three sides plus the crowd as the fourth; it holds.

frames.technical: Level, symmetric; a cut face at the right edge
frames.critique: The Hall straight on over its terraces, with the crowd filling the bottom third from edge to edge. As a statement of scale (one hall, thousands of people) it's direct, but the composition is a centred record with blank sky over the top 40%, and the crowd has no shape: no gap, no line, no figure to hold. 4169 does the crowd and the hall better, by giving the crowd a direction.

frames.technical: Clean; strong midday shadows on the paving
frames.critique: The two women in Qing robes, pink and pale blue, walk towards the Hall of Prayer with one phone between them, and their robes carry the hall's own colours, blue and gold on the embroidered hems against the blue and gold of the tiers above. That rhyme and the costume-and-phone juxtaposition make it the Temple of Heaven's people frame, the sequel to the palace's robed women. The woman in black at the left is a strong dark mass that balances them, though the man with the backpack tight beside them crowds the pair. Busy, but the busy-ness is the holiday.

frames.technical: Deep clean sky, no dust seen; the gold board holds
frames.critique: The Hall's three tiers stack up the right side on a diagonal from the bottom left, each eave a curved stripe of green brackets and red edge, with the gold-framed 祈年 board as the one bright point. The empty deep blue on the left is space the curves move into, not dead sky. The low angle makes the tiers overlap and recede. Of the close tier frames this is the strongest: the board gives it a focal point that 4180 lacks.
frames.focus: sharp (the tile-ends and swastika rafters, 100%); a cable crosses the board

frames.technical: Sky graduates lighter to the left; clean
frames.critique: The same tiers from a step further round, without the board; the sky is lighter and graduated, so the curves read softer. A good frame in the same idea as 4177, which does it better with its board and deeper blue. The other take, kept for the toss-up only if the page needs a quieter version.
frames.focus: sharp (the brackets under the bird netting, 100%)

frames.technical: Flare: green and violet blobs across the middle tier and the lower right; the sunstar clean; sky pale near the sun
frames.critique: The sun bursts from behind the top eave and throws its rays across the tiers: a dramatic idea that the bright rays and the backlit gold carry. The flare blobs are the cost, several of them right across the painted frieze, the frame's detail, and the backlight turns the hall's red to a muddy maroon. The city's blocks poking in at the bottom left don't help. A 3 for the energy; a cleaned edit could lift it.
frames.focus: sharp but veiled: the flare lowers contrast over the frieze

frames.technical: Deep clean sky; tiers render well
frames.critique: The 祈年殿 board centred under the finial, the tiers spreading below it in stripes: rich colour and well exposed, but static. The vertical axis of finial and board is the only line, the top third is plain sky, and the tiers run out of both sides of the frame, so it reads as a detail of the hall rather than a shape. 4177 has the same material and uses the sky as space for the diagonal.

frames.technical: Strong contrast: the foreground figures go to near silhouette; the hall and sky clean
frames.critique: The woman in the black Qing robe with its fur-trimmed cape and winged headdress stands in a pool of sun among the crowd, posing for someone's camera, with the Hall straight above. The dark figures at both edges work as a frame of silhouettes and push the eye in. But the people round her are at all distances and none of them separates: the pair in the middle looking at a phone sits right beside her, and the man at the right edge is a big dark mass. The costume is the frame's reason, and it doesn't quite get its own space.
frames.focus: sharp (the hands and the cape's fur, 100%); low light grain in the shadow

frames.technical: Clean; the face slightly warm; a camera body cut at the right edge
frames.critique: A young woman in cream hanfu with a gold hairpiece and a pink fan, posing for her own photographer, whose camera pokes in from the right edge, with the Hall of Prayer cut at the top left. The light on her is soft and her costume renders well; the hall placed off to the side gives the context without competing. But it's a portrait of a stranger whose face is the subject, the crowd behind her is busy at every distance, and her expression is a pose held for someone else. The camera at the edge tells the story (a costume shoot) but takes a black bite out of the frame. Your 4; a 3 here, and off the page like 4080, since her face is the point.
frames.focus: sharp (her face and the gold hairpiece, 100%)

frames.technical: Clean; strong shadows
frames.critique: Closer on the four robed women: the robes are bigger and the teddy-bear backpack reads, but the Hall shrinks into a gap between the trees and the corridor's bench crowd, the man in the pink backpack right beside them, takes the right half. 4209 gives the corridor's diagonal room to run to the Hall; this one trades the line for the costumes. Held stays held.

frames.technical: Clean; strong contrast, shadows deep but readable; sky clean
frames.critique: Four women in Qing robes, white, gold and red, walk away down the path beside the Long Corridor, and the corridor's red columns and green eave run in a strong diagonal to the Hall of Prayer, small and centred above the trees at the end. Line, people and landmark in one: the robes are the colour, the corridor is the direction, the hall is where they're going. The red backpack with its teddy bear on the white robe is the modern note in the costume. The dark shrubs on the left and the crowd on the corridor's bench on the right are heavy but fall away into the line. The Temple of Heaven's best people frame.
frames.focus: sharp (the embroidered robe and the bottle on the backpack, 100%); grain in the edit

frames.technical: Neutral edit, clean; the right side busy with the corridor's crowd
frames.critique: The landscape take of 4209, from closer: the robes are bigger and the girl in white raises her phone for a selfie, a better gesture than anything in the portrait. But the wider frame lets the corridor's bench crowd and the pink backpack take the whole right third, and the Hall at the end is smaller against more sky. The portrait concentrates the line; this one spreads it. The other orientation, a 3.

frames.technical: Clean sky; the boat's grey cover at the bottom is the darkest and nearest thing
frames.critique: The Wenchang tower on its gate across the inlet, the bridge of visitors running from it to the willows. The bridge is a good line through the frame and the willows' yellow-green is the season. But the moored boats and the grey canopy at the bottom right are the nearest, biggest shapes, the sky is 40% of the frame and empty, and the tower sits at the left edge with nothing to balance it but trees. A record with a strong foreground in the wrong place.

frames.technical: Through glass by design: the painted flowers on the pane, the lake beyond; scratches and haze on the glass; to check that the paint is sharp
frames.critique: Hand-painted flowers on a window pane float over Kunming Lake, and the sun's glitter on the water sits right behind them, so the painted petals and the real sparkle become one layer. A small found idea, and the arch of the window frame closes it. The glass's scratches and haze soften everything beyond, which is both the mood and the cost: the far shore is a grey smear and the right side's dark reflection is muddy. A playful frame for a page, not more.
frames.focus: sharp on the painted glass (100%); the lake beyond is soft through the pane, as expected

frames.technical: Clean; the shade holds detail; an orange backpack on the ground at the bottom right edge
frames.critique: A covered walk between a grey brick wall and a row of red columns, the painted beams stepping away overhead to a framed painting at the end. The lines converge on a small boy in a red jacket walking towards the camera, so the one red figure answers the red columns at the vanishing point. The brick wall's texture is a whole plane on the left, and the light from the right side gives the columns their roundness. The orange backpack at the bottom right is the brightest near object and pulls the eye from the boy: a crop from the right fixes it. A child's face is readable (stranger).

frames.technical: Moody, cooled edit; the beams hold detail; the open sides burn out a little on the left
frames.critique: Straight down the Long Corridor: the painted crossbeams repeat and shrink to a vanishing point, each with its little landscape panel, and that rhythm is strong. The crowd fills the bottom third shoulder to shoulder, which tells the truth about the corridor on a holiday, but it's cut at the bottom edge with heads nearest and darkest, and the man at the right reaching up is a stray gesture. The top half is the photo; the bottom half is the price of the day.

frames.technical: Dark, cool edit; the cartouche sharp; the background trees soft
frames.critique: One painted beam close up: a scene of scholars at a table in its scalloped cartouche, faded and flaking, with the red lattice under it and the dark ceiling slats above. The slats make diagonals that lead to the painting, and the flaking paint gives it age. But the cartouche sits left of centre with the right half given to plainer panels and a green post, and the bright trees beyond the lattice compete with the painting for the eye. A good detail for a corridor sequence.

frames.technical: Contrast high; the trunks deep in shade; a tree tag on each trunk
frames.critique: A stone arch bridge seen between two cypress trunks, its arch and its reflection closing into an oval in the dark pond, with one yellow ginkgo reflected at the bottom right. The arch-and-reflection is the frame's shape and the trunks make a frame round it. But the right trunk is very large and splits the frame two-thirds across, the visitors on the steps at the right edge are bright, and the drain grate at the bottom left is a hard pattern in the corner. Quiet and well seen, a 3 for the garden chapter.

frames.technical: Backlit leaves bright but holding; shallow depth, the gate soft
frames.critique: Yellow leaves lit from behind fill the right two-thirds, glowing against blue sky and a dark cypress, with the carved stone gate and its red-edged door soft below. The backlight is what the frame is about, the leaves translucent with their veins showing. But the leaves are spread evenly with no edge or shape to hold the eye, and the gate is half-hidden, so the eye finds no point to rest. A season frame that colours a chapter.

frames.technical: Shallow focus; to check the near petals at 100%; the white petals bright but holding
frames.critique: A white chrysanthemum caught in a shaft of sun while everything round it sits in shade, so the light isolates it like a spotlight, and the pink and yellow blooms behind it, softer and half-lit, give it depth and colour without competing. The ledge running diagonally to the bottom right is the one line, and it leads into the flower. The dark top left is heavy, but it's the shade that makes the light. The light does the work here, not the flower.
frames.focus: sharp (the white petals, 100%); second spot sharp too

frames.technical: Strong warm film-style edit, blacks lifted and crushed in places; to check the petals at 100%
frames.critique: A yellow chrysanthemum against the pavilion's red lacquer and a soft gold ornament, its curled petals lit from the side. Three colours only, yellow, red and the near-black green of the leaves, and they separate cleanly; the shallow focus turns the pavilion into colour fields that frame the bloom without a hard line. The heavy edit is a choice that suits it. The bright paving on the left is a blank patch next to the flower. At 100% no petal is crisp: the focus seems to have landed in front of or behind the bloom, and the grain of the edit hides it at display size. A close-up lives on its focus, so it's a 3, chosen only knowingly.
frames.focus: soft (two more spots on the bloom, 100%: no petal is crisp, and heavy grain from the edit on top); holds at display size

frames.technical: Clean; the yellow tree bright but holding; deep shade at the bottom
frames.critique: A garden scene in layers: the potted chrysanthemums standing on their tall stalks along the carved wall like a row of figures, the yellow tree glowing in sun behind, the stone gate and two cypress trunks framing it. The woman in the white jumper poses at the left, smiling for someone off-frame, and the woven bag on the ground is a nice ordinary note. As a composition it's good, the flowers repeating across the wall. But her face is the frame's main subject, she's a stranger posing, and the visitors at the gate behind her are busy. A 3, off the page as a posed portrait.

frames.technical: Shallow focus; to check the petals at 100%; backlit petals bright
frames.critique: A pink chrysanthemum lit from behind, its petals translucent at the edges, against a dark trunk and a soft pavilion. The backlight is lovely on the curled petals. But the frame has no clear space: the trunk takes the right third, a yellow bloom is cut by the right edge in the corner, and the soft people behind sit just above the flower. 4261 does the light-in-shade idea more cleanly.

frames.technical: The sky through the opening is blown near white; the shade holds; lattice shadows crisp on the floor
frames.critique: From inside a pavilion, the red lattice and a column split the view into two panels of lakeshore: visitors walking past ginkgos turning yellow, the lake a pale band behind. The lattice's shadows thrown across the floor repeat its pattern in light, which is the nicest thing in it. But the sky fills the upper half of each panel with white, the lake has no tone, and the robed figure cut at the right edge and the bins in the middle panel are the details nearest the eye. A frame within a frame where the frame is better than the view.

frames.technical: Clean; deep shade under the trees
frames.critique: The Tower small at the top of a gap in the trees, a lawn in sun across the bottom third and a dark hall in shade under it. Your 3; a 2 here, because the lawn and the trees are most of the frame and do nothing but fill it: no line leads up the hill, and the Tower is too small to hold the top. 4334 and 4277 do the Tower from below with a frame. Mihail at review (2026-11-05): "I really like" it; on the page in place of 4277 as his pick, at its rating.

frames.technical: Clean; deep shade at the bottom; the roofs warm in sun
frames.critique: The curving top of an old wall sweeps from the lower left up and across, its row of round tile-ends leading to the glazed roofs of the temple above, and the trees close round the top in a dark ring, so the sky becomes a keyhole with the roofs at its foot. Old grey brick and weeds below, gilded gable above: the climb up Longevity Hill in one frame. The bright leaves at the bottom right are a little loud. A view found, not taken.

frames.technical: Clean; the red wall in shade, near black at the bottom
frames.critique: The Tower over its pale terrace and the red wall's tiled top, framed by two cypresses, one at each side, against a blue sky. A different idea from 4334's roofs: the trees as a natural frame, the wall as a dark base. The red wall in shade takes the bottom third as a heavy block and the left cypress is soft. A good 3, the Tower with the trees; it doesn't change the scene.

frames.technical: Warm film-style edit with lifted blacks; colour rich, reds strong but toned; crowd heads at the bottom right
frames.critique: The Long Corridor's painted roof from below: the beam with its peony panel comes in from the top left, the corner turns, and the crossbeams with their little landscapes march off to the right in a long recession. The colour is the subject, and the corner gives it a shape: a diagonal into depth, with the striped ceiling slats as a dark field over it. The heads at the bottom right remind you of the crowd without taking over. The corridor's richest frame.
frames.focus: sharp (the ceiling slats, 100%); grain from the edit

frames.technical: Same warm edit; the crowd's heads dark across the bottom fifth
frames.critique: The portrait take of the corridor ceiling: the crossbeams' cartouches stack up the frame into a long tunnel, which the vertical does better than 4280, but it loses the peony beam and the corner that gave 4280 its diagonal, and the crowd's heads fill the bottom. Your 2; a 3 here as the other orientation, not on the page beside 4280.

frames.technical: Deep clean sky; no dust seen; the yellow glaze holds
frames.critique: Two eaves of the same hall stacked against a deep blue, each ridge with its procession of glazed beasts in silhouette, and a third roof below at the right taking the line down into the trees. The repetition of eave over eave gives it a rhythm, and the hard side light separates every bracket. The red columns at the bottom ground it. Very much a roof-detail frame of the kind the palace already has, but a clean one. Down to 3 on a second pass over the 4s: clean, but it adds nothing the palace's roof frames don't already have.
frames.focus: sharp (the glazed ridge, 100%); the crop also shows a cable running along the ridge

frames.technical: Pale sky; a cable and the bird netting cross the top left; the second edit, better than 4287
frames.critique: The corner of a hall from below, its brackets fanning out in tiers of green, blue and gold to the upturned ridge, with sun on the red columns. The bracket set is dense and beautifully rendered. But the frame is all detail with no shape to hold it: the dark eave of the neighbouring roof hangs in at the top left, a cable runs across the sky, and the pale sky gives the corner no contrast to stand out against. 4286 does the eaves more cleanly.
frames.focus: sharp (the rafter ends and swastika panels, 100%)

frames.technical: Deep sky, clean; the tree at the left in deep shadow
frames.critique: Looking up the terrace wall at the Tower of Buddhist Incense: the gallery along the wall top and the zigzag-tiled parapet make a bold diagonal from the left into the frame, and the pale stone face is a strong flat plane. But a cypress stands right in front of the Tower and hides half of it, so the frame's goal is clipped by a tree, and the dark tree at the left edge is a heavy mass. The diagonal is good; the subject is stacked behind something else.

frames.technical: A blurred roof tile at the bottom right edge; clean otherwise
frames.critique: Looking down into a courtyard on the hill: the orange-tiled galleries come in at angles, the hall's roof steps down from the top right, and a woman in a lilac Qing robe stands in the courtyard among ordinary visitors, a small costume figure seen from above. The lake shows through a gap at the top. The angles of the roofs give it energy and the robe is a good accent. But the courtyard has people scattered everywhere with no grouping, and the blurred tile in the bottom corner is the nearest thing. A busy courtyard that rewards looking.

frames.technical: Clean; slight haze on the far city; sky smooth
frames.critique: Kunming Lake from the hill: the roofs and trees of the palace across the bottom, the lake, the island and its Seventeen-Arch Bridge, and the city with the CCTV tower on the horizon. The layers are all there and the bridge is a line through the middle distance. But the lake is a flat blue field across half the frame, the sky a third, and the island small: the view everyone takes, done squarely, with nothing near to anchor it. Could open the place as 'here we are'.
frames.focus: sharp (the island's hall and bridge, 100%); haze on the far shore

frames.technical: Clean; the courtyard below busy
frames.critique: The lake from the hill in portrait, with the courtyards and grey roofs of the halls stacked below in place of 4320's one glazed roof. The extra architecture is busy, dark and spread across the bottom, while 4320's single roof corner leads the eye down to the water. A 3.

frames.technical: Clean; the painted lintel and the lake both hold; faces in the crowd readable
frames.critique: From inside the Tower of Buddhist Incense: the painted lintel and the red door frame cut a bright rectangle out of the dark, and in it sits the whole reason for the climb, the lake, the island with its bridge, and the city with the CCTV tower on the horizon. Below, the crowd pushes in, faces turned up and phones out. The frame within a frame is strong on its own, and the crowd turns it into a frame about being there on a holiday: the view is small and calm, the people below are many and busy. The bottom half is busy by nature. Faces readable, strangers.
frames.focus: sharp (the view through the door, 100%); haze on the city

frames.technical: Deep clean sky; no dust seen; the tilt is the low angle, clearly intended
frames.critique: The Tower of Buddhist Incense straight up from its base, its galleries and eaves stacking into a deep blue sky at a steep diagonal. The red columns and balustrades repeat on every storey, so the climb of the building is the rhythm, and the colours of the painted friezes come out in the hard sun. The sky on the left balances the mass. A strong looking-up frame of the Summer Palace's landmark, the kin of 4177 at the Temple of Heaven.

frames.technical: The window bars in the foreground deliberately soft; the lake sharp
frames.critique: Through a dark window grille: the soft bars cut the frame into stacked panes, sky with clouds at the top, the lake with the island and the Seventeen-Arch Bridge in the middle, and the orange roofs below. Each pane holds one layer of the view, which is a clever way to organise a wide view. But the bars are heavy, a third of the frame in dark blur, and the middle pane, the one that matters, is a calm but small view. An idea that works more on the page as a variation than on its own.

frames.technical: The window bars in the foreground sharp here, the view beyond sharp
frames.critique: The landscape take through the window grille: the bars cut the view into six panes, each with a slice of lake, island, city and sky, and here the bars are sharp, a graphic grid rather than 4309's soft veil. The panes are small and the grid dominates, so it's the frame more than the view. A real variation of 4309, at the same 3.

frames.technical: Clean sky, no dust; graduated to pale at the horizon
frames.critique: A single cumulus floats in a deep blue sky over Kunming Lake, with the island, the Seventeen-Arch Bridge and the CCTV tower in a narrow band at the bottom. The cloud's shape is the subject and it sits well, upper right of centre, balanced by the island at the bottom left. Minimal and calm. But the light on the lake is flat midday and the cloud is a nice shape rather than a striking one, so the frame relies on its emptiness. A quiet 3 that can rest a sequence; it could be a 4 for you.

frames.technical: Clean; light haze on the far range that separates the layers; heads cut at the bottom edge
frames.critique: From the Tower's terrace to the west: the pale stone wall as a hard near edge on the right, the stair and the little pavilions dropping down the hill, the autumn trees, a lobe of the lake, then Jade Spring Hill with its pagoda in silhouette against the Western Hills. Each layer separates by tone, darker to paler, and the pagoda is the one point the eye goes to. The sky is a third of the frame and plain, and the visitors' heads cut at the bottom are the nearest things. The wide view of the place with structure in it. Down to 3 once the held 4315 was seen: the same view without the heads at the bottom.

frames.focus: judged at 1000px beside 4314; sharp at 100% on the pagoda (crop below)
frames.technical: Clean; a CCTV camera on the gallery corner at the top right
frames.critique: The landscape take of 4314 and the cleaner one: the Tower terrace's pale wall and its green-and-yellow glazed parapet make a hard right edge, and in the space left of it Jade Spring Hill and its pagoda sit centred between the trees under the Western Hills, with a lobe of the lake and the little pavilions below. No heads at the bottom, a calmer sky, and the wall's warm stone against the cool distance. The camera on the gallery is small. Pulled to the page's choice for the view west; 4314 becomes the portrait take.

frames.technical: Clean; the wall bright in sun but holding texture
frames.critique: The great stone wall of the Tower's terrace fills the left third, and beside it the long stair climbs from the bottom to a cluster of people at the top, with the orange-and-green railing running down the right of it like a drawn line. Beyond, the trees and the city's towers under a blue sky with a few clouds. The vertical frame gives the stair its steepness, and the people on it give the scale. Busy at the bottom right, but every part of it is about the climb.

frames.technical: Clean
frames.critique: The landscape take of 4320: the same roof corner and ridge beast, smaller, with more lake and the island to the right. In landscape the roof sits as a strip along the bottom rather than a diagonal into the view, so the frame loses the lead-in. The other orientation, a 3.

frames.technical: Clean; the glazed tiles glow without clipping; sky smooth
frames.critique: The orange glazed roofs of the hill's halls fill the bottom half in steep diagonals, the ridge beast at the gable corner pointing out to the lake, and beyond them Kunming Lake, the island and its bridge, and the city. The near roofs are what 4299 lacked: a foreground with colour and line that takes you down to the water. The sky is plain but has a few clouds. The dark cypress at the bottom right is heavy. The better view of the lake from the hill.
frames.focus: sharp (the tiles and the peeling gilt, 100%)

frames.technical: Warm, contrasty edit; clean; an adult cut at the right edge
frames.critique: A little girl in a lilac sweatshirt, holding a round fan, presses a sleeve to her face against a wall of green and yellow glazed tiles laid in a lattice. The lilac against the green and yellow is the frame's colour, and the diagonal of the roof ridge above gives it a slope. Her face is hidden, so it's a gesture, a small private moment in a public place. The adult cut at the right edge is the blemish, and the paving takes the bottom quarter. A child, a stranger, face not visible.
frames.focus: sharp (her sweatshirt and the fan's handle, 100%)

frames.technical: Clean; the sky smooth; a few clouds at the top
frames.critique: The lake framed between a bare-topped tree with a magpie's nest on the left and a pine on the right, with the orange roof ridges of the hill's halls along the bottom and the island and bridge in the gap. The frame of trees is natural and the roof ridge makes a good near edge. But the sky over the gap is 40% of the frame, the near roof is a long flat band, and the view is the same lake as 4320 without its diagonal. A variation that holds up.

frames.technical: Backlit; the sky and the lake go pale near white at the top; the roofs glow without clipping
frames.critique: Looking down over the hill's roofs towards the lake against the afternoon light: the orange glazed roofs layer one behind another, gables and ridges at angles, their tiles rimmed with light, and the dark cypresses push up between them. The roofs are the subject and the backlight gives them texture, warm against the cool green. The lake and the far shore are a bright, pale band across the top, which works as a ground but has little in it. A frame of the hill's architecture rather than of the view. Down to 3 on a second pass over the 4s: the pale lake band across the top is half the frame and empty.

frames.technical: Low angle; sun glinting off the gable behind; the undersides dark but holding
frames.critique: Two eaves of a long hall from below, the nearer one cutting across the top right, the farther one running away in a long diagonal to the left, the gilded gable between them catching the sun. The recession of the colonnade gives it depth and the glint gives it a point. But the frame is dense from edge to edge, the cypress at the top left is a soft mass, and the roof-from-below idea is done more cleanly in 4286 and 4307. A good 3.

frames.technical: Clean deep sky; the dark eave on the left goes near black but has edge detail
frames.critique: The Tower of Buddhist Incense rises over a stack of golden roofs, framed by the dark underside of an eave on the left and the red and gold gable of a hall on the right, with a cloud beside it. Every layer is a different plane and colour: dark frame, golden tiles, painted friezes, the Tower, the blue. The gable's diagonal and the eave's curve both lead to it. The shrub at the bottom right is the only loose part. The best of the Tower frames.

frames.technical: Clean deep sky; the doors below in shade
frames.critique: A portrait take from lower down: the Tower, the golden roofs, the red gable, and below them the hall's doors and columns. The extra bottom adds the hall's door but loses the eave frame on the left, so it reads looser than both 4334 and 4336. A 3.

frames.technical: Clean deep sky; the near eave dark with edge detail
frames.critique: The portrait take of 4334: the Tower sits higher and more central, with the pale stepped wall of its terrace below it as a clean white plane between the golden roofs and the tower. The dark eave on the left and the red gable on the right still frame it. The vertical frame gives the climb from the courtyard to the Tower more room, at the cost of a bigger shrub at the bottom right. A toss-up with 4334: this one has more height, that one more balance.

frames.technical: Clean; the yellow leaves bright but holding; a cloud behind the Tower
frames.critique: The Tower of Buddhist Incense over a yellow-leaved tree, with a painted eave and a pine branch on the right and a white cloud just behind the Tower. Autumn and the landmark in one. But the yellow tree is a single undifferentiated mass across the bottom half, and the right side, eave, pine and red column, is crowded, so the Tower sits small between two busy halves. 4334 does the Tower with far more structure.
frames.focus: sharp but a shade softer than 4334 (the Tower's balconies, 100%); fine at display size

frames.technical: Backlit; the lake sparkles without clipping badly; a CCTV dome hangs at the top right; face readable
frames.critique: A young woman in a tan jacket sits on the pavilion's rail between two red columns, reading her phone, while the lake glitters behind her. The columns frame her in a tall panel, the warm light falls on her jacket and the red, and the lattice under the rail throws its shadow pattern on the floor. The surveillance camera hanging over her from the beam is the frame's modern note and pulls the eye hard, but it's part of the place and, next to a woman absorbed in her phone, reads as a wry detail rather than an accident. A candid stranger, face readable. Your 4 stands.
frames.focus: sharp (her hands, the phone and the coat, 100%)

frames.technical: The open sides blow to white; the interior holds; the door at the right edge goes black
frames.critique: Through a dark doorway into a lakeside pavilion: the painted beams overhead, the lattice panels, and in the opening a woman in a Qing robe raising her arm for a photo at the left and visitors taking pictures at the right. The doorway and the column make a frame, and the paving's light and shadow lead in. But the lake behind is a white blank, so the opening has no view, and the people are spread across it with no single moment. A busy interior with good bones.

frames.technical: Backlit; the man near silhouette; the lattice shadows crisp
frames.critique: From the corridor, a young man in silhouette leans on a column over the glittering lake, the lattice's shadow thrown across the floor in a hard pattern. The light and the shadow pattern are lovely; the man is dark and shapeless against the column, and the right side's lake and sky are a plain bright field. A mood frame, a 3.

frames.technical: Clean; the trees' shade side dark but readable; a red rail across the bottom
frames.critique: The marble balustrade of the lakeside path runs away in a long diagonal from the bottom right to the pier, with the dark cypresses arching over it and the Jade Spring pagoda small on its hill at the end. A good line and a good destination. But the red rail and the lattice under it fill the bottom fifth as a hard flat band in front of everything, and the man in pink at the right is the nearest and brightest figure. The upper two-thirds is a clean 4; the foreground holds it to a 3.

frames.technical: The sky paler than 4349's; the lattice and beam at the top dark
frames.critique: The same path from inside the pavilion, with its painted beam and lattice as a frame across the top. The frame is a good idea and turns the path into a view from somewhere, but it doubles the bands: lattice at the top, red bench and rail at the bottom, so the path and the pagoda are squeezed between two dark strips, and the sky is washed. 4349 stays the pick, both at 3.

frames.technical: The crowd near black across the bottom third; the pavilion and sky clean
frames.critique: A pavilion on the hill seen up through the corridor's painted beam and the trees, framed above by the lattice, the clouds bright behind it, and below the dark mass of the crowd eating in the corridor. The frame round the pavilion is rich; the crowd is a black third. A 3.

frames.technical: Clean; the stone finial in the foreground deliberately soft
frames.critique: The Marble Boat side-on across the water in clear afternoon light, the dragon boats moored at the left and a cypress hanging in at the right. The boat is well lit and sits in the middle third. The blurred stone finial at the bottom right is meant as a near layer but reads as an obstruction: it's large, grey and shapeless at this blur, right where the eye enters. 4361 uses the same finial far better.

frames.technical: Clean
frames.critique: The dragon boats moored in a row across the lake, the Marble Boat's prow cut at the right edge, the Western Hills behind, and a chain fence and two ducks in the foreground. The row of boats and the hills are a calm band, but the Marble Boat is cut in half and the chain fence is a foreground without a purpose. A 3 record of the boats.

frames.technical: Clean sky with clouds; the finial in focus; long shadows on the paving
frames.critique: The portrait take, with the carved stone finial tall in the right foreground, its lotus shape against the pavement and the chained posts leading the eye in a diagonal to the Marble Boat. Now the near layer is a subject in its own right and rhymes with the boat's stone. The sky with its clouds and the cypress branch close the top. The paving takes a lot of the bottom, but its shadow lines carry it. At 100% the finial, the frame's near subject, is soft: the focus went to the boat. It holds at display size, but it costs the star.
frames.focus: the boat sharp, the near finial soft (second spot, 100%): the frame is built on the finial

frames.technical: Clean; the ginkgo bright but holding; sky with one long cloud
frames.critique: A quiet inlet: the stone embankment runs back from the left, the yellow ginkgos glow above it, and the lakeside pavilion with its red columns stands on the right, its reflection in the water. The ginkgo's yellow against the blue is the season's colour and the stone walls lead the eye into the inlet. But the water fills the bottom third with little in it, and the frame is split between the tree on the left and the pavilion on the right with an empty middle. Calm, a 3 that colours the chapter.

frames.technical: Clean deep sky; no dust seen; the marble holds in sun
frames.critique: The Marble Boat from its stern, its two storeys of carved stone and arched windows running out to the prow, with the lake opening on the right to the CCTV tower and the clouds streaming over. The near-twin of 4370, a step closer: the stern's corner and a stone post come in at the bottom left and the boat is cropped harder at the left, so it reads less as a whole boat. 4370 settles it; this is the backup.

frames.technical: Clean; the dragon boat at the right edge cut by the frame
frames.critique: The landscape take: the Marble Boat on the left, a moored dragon boat on the right, and the open lake between them running to the CCTV tower on the horizon. The two boats, stone and painted wood, face each other across the water and frame the distance, which the portrait can't do. The clouds are scattered rather than shaped and the dragon boat is cut at the right edge, but the cut makes it a frame, not a subject. The other orientation, with its own idea.

frames.technical: Clean deep sky; the darker patch on the water at the right is the wind's ripple, not an edit; no dust
frames.critique: The Marble Boat whole, from stern to prow, on a clean diagonal into the lake, its stone pale against a deep blue, the CCTV tower small on the far shore, and long clouds overhead that lead the same way as the boat. The afternoon light picks out the carving and the paddle wheel, and the boat's reflection breaks the water below. The boat is half the frame and the rest is lake and sky that give it room. The Summer Palace's postcard frame, done with structure.
frames.focus: sharp (the carved base and peeling paint, 100%)

frames.technical: Backlit; the sun flares at the right edge; the leaves bright but holding
frames.critique: A whole ginkgo in full yellow, backlit against a blue sky, its trunk splitting into branches that fan out. The colour is intense and the translucent leaves glow. But the tree fills the frame from edge to edge with no space round it, a second ginkgo crowds the top right with the sun burning through, and the dark pines at both sides cut in. It's the season at full volume, a colour frame rather than a composition.

frames.technical: Grain in the sky from the edit; a 16:9 crop
frames.critique: The far shore's willows and ginkgos in late gold, a long row of trees with walkers small under them, the lake across the bottom and plain sky above. In the wide 16:9 crop the trees become one warm band, which is calm and suits the season, but the frame is three stripes of equal weight with no line or point to stop at. A quiet 3, the shore as a band.

frames.technical: Clean; the water's shade side dark but readable; sky with clouds
frames.critique: A stone-lined channel runs into the frame from the bottom right, its walls stepping in and out in a zigzag, and the autumn trees in yellow, ochre and green pile up along the far bank under a long white cloud. The light rakes across the stone and catches the trees from the side, so every layer, water, wall, foliage, sky, separates by tone and colour. The cut wall at the right edge leads in rather than blocks. A quiet, well-built frame with no landmark in it. Mihail at review (2026-11-05): 4 to 3, "probably a 3 star".
frames.focus: sharp (the far bank's trees and the walkers, 100%)

frames.technical: Backlit; the glitter on the water bright, not clipped badly; the post a silhouette
frames.critique: Willow fronds hang from the top like a curtain, the lake glitters in a path of sun, and a single carved balustrade post stands in silhouette right in that path, with the pavilion small on the far shore. Three layers, each with its own light: green-gold fronds against the sky, sparkling water, black stone. The post placed in the glitter is the frame's point. The balustrade's dark bulk takes the bottom fifth and the tree's trunk the top right corner, but both frame rather than block. Light doing the work.
frames.focus: sharp (the post's carving in silhouette, 100%); sunstar from the glitter

frames.technical: Clean; a branch in the top right corner
frames.critique: The Marble Boat's prow and stern pavilion at the right, the dragon boats beyond it, the autumn shore and the Western Hills. The prow's curl is a good shape, but the boat is cut at the right edge and the frame is a long thin band of everything at the same distance. 4370 has the whole boat. A 3.

frames.technical: Clean; the shade at the bottom deep; the girls' faces not visible
frames.critique: Two girls at the marble rail under a cypress, heads together over a phone, one in a red-and-white striped jumper, with the lake and the far shore beyond. The branch closing over the top and the two finials at the edges frame the scene, and the stripes are the colour. But the girls fill the middle and block the view they came for, with backs to us and no gesture beyond looking at a phone, and the paving takes the bottom fifth. A pleasant moment that doesn't quite become one. Strangers, faces not visible.

frames.technical: Moody, cool edit, the balustrade near black; sky clean
frames.critique: The balustrade's finials in silhouette across the bottom, the lake a wide blue band, the island and the CCTV tower on the horizon, and cypress branches closing the top corners. Calm and well balanced, with the near-black rail as a strong base. But the lake band is a plain field and the horizon is low and small, so the frame is mostly frame. 4386 does the post-against-water idea with light.
frames.focus: sharp (the far shore and the water, 100%)

frames.technical: Clean; the balustrade's shade side dark; a CCTV dome under the eave
frames.critique: The marble balustrade runs from the bottom right corner in a long curve to the lakeside pavilion, each finial a beat in the rhythm, and the pavilion's red columns and grey roof stand over the water under a sky full of cloud. The side light models every finial and lays the balustrade's shadow along the path. The pavilion is full of visitors, which at this size reads as life, not clutter. The cypress at the top left is a dark weight. A strong line to a strong subject in good light.

frames.technical: Clean; the faces readable in the shade; the sky over the lake pale
frames.critique: Four young women on the pavilion's rail: one flicks her hair with her eyes closed, the other three look into their phones, and behind them the lake, the cypress-lined causeway and the Jade Spring pagoda on its hill. The pavilion's lattice and beam frame the scene, the lattice shadows pattern the floor, and the hair-flick against the three bowed heads is the frame's moment: a picture of an afternoon on a holiday, anyone's afternoon. The pale sky on the left is a blank. Strangers, faces readable: check.

frames.technical: Contrast extreme: the corridor near black, the lake bright; the bottom third a black mass
frames.critique: Inside a dark lakeside corridor, a woman in a beret stands in silhouette at the rail, framed by its columns, with the sunlit lake and the walkers on the shore beyond. The silhouette and the lattice shadows on the floor are strong, and the framing is clean. But the bottom third is solid black with nothing in it, and the woman is placed among the other walkers on the far path, so she doesn't separate from them. A 4:5 crop from the bottom would give it shape.
frames.focus: sharp enough (the silhouette's edge, 100%); the frame is a silhouette, focus not critical

frames.technical: Clean; the balustrade in shade
frames.critique: Two carved finials of the lakeside balustrade in the near right, the lake wide behind them, the Wenchang tower small on the far shore, and a cypress branch hanging over the top under clouds. The finials are big and well modelled and the branch closes the frame, but the far shore is a thin strip and the finials sit in a corner with the water as a plain field. 4397 makes the balustrade a line to a subject; this is its quieter cousin, a 3.

frames.technical: Sun in frame: veiling flare across the trees and a green ghost at the bottom; the water's glitter bright
frames.critique: The sun hangs over a row of willows on the lakeshore, the crowd under them in silhouette, the light breaking into a glitter path across the choppy water. The willows lean in the wind and the light makes them glow at the edges. But the flare washes the middle of the frame, the sun is a big blown disc with nothing to shape it, and the crowd is a dark band. The light is the idea, and it overpowers the frame.
frames.focus: sharp (the crowd under the willows, 100%), contrast lowered by flare

frames.technical: Sun in frame, less flare than 4413; glitter on the water
frames.critique: The landscape take: the whole row of willows leaning over the shore with the pavilion half-hidden at the left, the crowd under them, the sun over the middle and the Western Hills at the right. Wider, it gains a shape, the willows' crowns making a long arc against the sky, and the flare is weaker. But the crowd is still a dark band across the middle and the sun still a blank disc. The better of the pair, a 3.

frames.technical: Clean; sky smooth; the speedboat's red bright
frames.critique: Longevity Hill across the water with the Tower of Buddhist Incense on its terrace, the willows on the left as a near frame, the covered boat piers stretching in from the right and the red speedboat as an accent below them. The willows, the piers and the boat give the classic view a foreground and a middle, and the late light warms the hill. The sky is the top 40% and plain, and the visitors under the willows are cut at the left edge. The establishing frame for the Summer Palace.

frames.technical: Clean; plain sky over the top 40%
frames.critique: The portrait take of 4416: one willow at the left, the piers and the red speedboat, the hill and the Tower, and the water. Portrait gives the hill less width and the sky more, so the Tower sits as a small point in a tall frame. The other orientation, a 3.

frames.technical: Low late sun; the wall's stains and the tree's shadow crisp; the rail's paint peeling
frames.critique: The Wenchang Pavilion on its stone gate lit by low warm sun, the weathered wall stained and patched, a willow's shadow thrown across it, and the pavilion's green roofs against a blue sky with clouds. The red and green railing in the foreground, peeling and in shadow, gives a near layer in the same colours as the pavilion above. The light picks out the age of the stone, which is the frame's texture. The rail takes a quarter of the frame. Strong light on a strong shape.
frames.focus: sharp (the stone gate and window lattice, 100%)

frames.technical: Clean; slight vignette on the water; sky smooth
frames.critique: The same view of Longevity Hill across the open lake, wider and without the willows: the hill, the Tower, the Western Hills on the left, and the piers cut at the right. The empty water across the bottom 40% and the plain sky on top leave the hill as a band in the middle. 4416 does the view with a foreground; this is its plainer twin.

frames.technical: Clean; strong shadows; the paving takes the bottom 40%
frames.critique: The portrait take of the girl in the panda hood shading her eyes at the lake's edge, her friend on the bench beside her, with Jade Spring Hill and the Western Hills across the choppy water and willow leaves over the top. The willow frame and the hills are lovely, but the paving and the drain cover fill the bottom 40% and the friend is hidden behind the bench, so the two never talk. 4432 tells it.

frames.technical: Clean; the wind-whipped water renders well; faces not visible
frames.critique: Two friends in matching panda hoods by Kunming Lake: one stands at the edge with an arm flung up, posing, the other sits on the red bench photographing her, and across the wind-ruffled water Longevity Hill and the Tower of Buddhist Incense sit in the late sun under the willow fronds. The story reads at once and it's a sweet one: the landmark is the backdrop for their own picture, as it is for everyone that day. The bench is the near layer and points into the scene. The paving at the bottom is a little heavy. Strangers, faces not visible.
frames.focus: sharp (the girl's hood and the water, 100%)

frames.technical: Sun at the top left corner, a flare glow; the water's glitter bright
frames.critique: The Seventeen-Arch Bridge running to the island, the crowd strung along its top, the Western Hills behind and the wind-chopped lake in front. The bridge is a good long line and the arches glow faintly. But it's small and low in a wide frame, the choppy water takes the bottom half, the sky the top half, and the pier's tyres at the bottom left are an awkward corner. A wide record of the bridge.

frames.technical: Clean; the arches warm in the late sun; deep blue water
frames.critique: The Seventeen-Arch Bridge from close to its end: the arches step away from the right edge in a long curve to the Kuoru pavilion, each vault lit gold inside by the low sun, with the crowd strung along the parapet and big clouds above. The curve and the recession of the arches do the work, and the warm stone against the dark blue water and blue sky is the colour. The water takes the bottom 40%, a lot of plain dark blue. The bridge's frame.
frames.focus: sharp (the arch, a duck on the water, 100%)

frames.technical: Clean; the vaults warm; a dark shape at the bottom right corner (a post?) at the edge
frames.critique: The landscape take of the bridge: it sweeps in from the right in a long shallow arc to the pavilion on the left, the vaults lit gold one after another and shrinking with distance, the crowd along the top, and broad clouds that echo the arc. The landscape frame gives the bridge its full length, which is its nature, and the reflections of the gold vaults break on the water. The nearest arch is cut by the right edge. Your 4; the bridge in its best light.

frames.technical: Clean; the near finials in shade with detail; the vaults warm
frames.critique: The same bridge with the shore's carved finials marching in from the bottom right, dark grey in shade against the gold-lit arches beyond. The finials give it a near layer and a second rhythm that answers the arches, and they push the bridge back so its curve reads as distance. The near finial is large and a little heavy, and the water in the middle is wide. A real variation on 4444: one is about the bridge, this one about standing on the shore looking at it.

frames.technical: Clean; warm late light on the hill; the near water dark
frames.critique: Longevity Hill straight across the lake, the Tower of Buddhist Incense centred, the hill a long band of autumn trees in warm late light, and a big cloud mass over it. Symmetrical and calm, the cloud balancing the Tower. But the hill is a thin band in the middle with the dark water filling the bottom 40% and the sky the top half; the composition is the postcard and nothing near anchors it. 4416 does the view with a foreground.

frames.technical: Backlit maple bright and holding; the crowd in shadow at the bottom; faces readable
frames.critique: A maple in full orange arches over Kunming Lake, backlit so every leaf glows, and under it a young woman in a beret poses for friends while others hold up phones. The tree is the most colourful thing in the whole day and its branch makes a strong diagonal. But the crowd's dark heads fill the bottom third, the posing woman's face is readable and she's a stranger posing for someone else, and the frame splits between the tree on the left and the plain lake on the right. The tree deserved a cleaner frame. Strangers, check.

frames.technical: Low light; the crowd near black; some noise in the dark foreground; sky gradient clean
frames.critique: From Jingshan just after sunset: the sky runs from violet through peach to orange at the horizon, the city's skyline a thin dark band, and the crowd in silhouette across the bottom third holding up a constellation of lit phone screens. The phones are the idea: a hundred small copies of the sunset. But the skyline is too thin to hold anything and the crowd's mass is a third of the frame with no shape, the phones scattered rather than gathered. 4465 makes the same point with the palace in it.
frames.focus: sharp on the skyline (100%); the phones in front soft by distance

frames.technical: Shallow focus by design: the phones and heads soft, the Shenwu Gate sharp-ish; check noise at 100%
frames.critique: The Forbidden City's Shenwu Gate lit gold in the dusk, seen between a forest of raised phones, every screen showing its own small version of the same view. The hands and phones frame the gate in a ring, the sky's gradient from violet to peach sits over the city lights, and the soft foreground makes the gate the one sharp thing. It's about how a view is met now, and it says it without sneering. The heads at the bottom are dense. Your 4; the night chapter's people frame.
frames.focus: soft-intended: the phone and hand in the foreground are sharp, the gate on the screen and beyond softer; at display size the gate reads, but the sharpest thing is a stranger's phone; second spot on the gate's roof soft (100%)
judged at 1000px beside 4470; the heads soft by distance
frames.technical: The crowd's heads and a lit phone soft across the bottom fifth
frames.critique: The Shenwu Gate view, slightly tighter, with heads and a raised phone in the bottom right corner. The phone does tell how the view was met, but here it's an accident at the edge, not 4465's ring of screens. A 3 between the clean view and the phones frame.

frames.technical: Clean sky; the foreground heads soft and dark
frames.critique: The portrait take from Jingshan: the Shenwu Gate lit, its court a pale rectangle, the palace roofs to the horizon, a big violet sky above, and the heads of the crowd soft and dark across the bottom fifth. The vertical gives the axis its depth, the gate, the hall behind and the city beyond stacked up the frame. But the heads are a heavy block, not a frame, and the top half is empty sky. 4470 does the view cleaner; this is the portrait for a toss-up.

frames.technical: Clean; low noise in the sky; the lit gate holds without clipping; slight warm cast on the roofs
frames.critique: The Forbidden City from Jingshan at dusk: the Shenwu Gate lit gold on the axis, its moat and red wall a dark horizontal, and behind it the palace's roofs in hundreds of overlapping planes running to the city's lit buildings and a violet-to-peach sky. The symmetry is exact, the lit gate is the one bright point, and the darkening roofs give it depth layer by layer, so the eye goes in along the axis as far as it can. The lit trees at the bottom are a warm near layer. It's the view, done as well as it can be done from there: asked what could be better, very little. A candidate for the portfolio.
frames.focus: sharp (the Shenwu Gate's board and roof tiles, 100%); slight noise in the shadows, fine

frames.technical: Clean; the same light as 4470
frames.critique: The near-twin of 4470, a second apart: a touch lower, so the lit gatehouse at the bottom sits nearer the edge and the sky is a little bigger. Equally good; 4470 has the gate a touch more central and the lower trees glow more. Your 4, held as the backup.

frames.technical: Clean blue sky, no noise to speak of; the lit trees warm at the bottom
frames.critique: The moon high in a deepening blue sky over the city east of the palace, the corner tower small at the left, and the lit trees glowing gold at the bottom. The moon's placement, high and off centre in a huge empty sky, is a quiet minimal idea, and the blue-to-gold from top to bottom is lovely. But the city band is busy with modern blocks, and the moon is a tiny point, so the emptiness isn't quite earned. A quiet 3 that rests the night chapter.

frames.technical: Clean; the lit trees at the bottom glare a little; a blurred rail at the bottom left
frames.critique: The CBD's towers, the CITIC tower tallest, catching the last light on the horizon, with the Forbidden City's corner tower lit small at the right and Jingshan's dark slope and lit trees in the foreground. Old and new in one frame, at very different sizes. But the hillside's dark green fills the bottom half and the lights in it are glare spots, the rail at the bottom left is an intrusion, and the sky is a plain blue top third. The idea's better than the frame.

frames.technical: Clean; the lit trees glare at the bottom
frames.critique: The landscape take of the CBD from Jingshan: the towers are a thin strip, the dark hillside the bottom half, and the lit trees two glare spots. Without 4488's vertical sky, the city is just a band. A 2.

frames.technical: Low noise in the sky; the lit brackets clean; cables along the ridge and a CCTV camera on the column
frames.critique: Jingshan's Wanchun Pavilion from below, lit from underneath so its double eaves blaze gold and green against a deep blue night sky, the long dark eave of the lower roof sweeping out to the right like a wing. The contrast between the lit upper tiers and the dark under-eave gives it a strong diagonal shape, and the red columns and blue beams below are rich. The cables and the camera are small. A strong colour-and-shape frame of the night. Down to 3 on a second pass: four pavilion frames at 4 is a repeat; 4499, 4500 and 4507 each do one thing better.

frames.technical: The dark slope takes the bottom 40% with noise; the sky clean
frames.critique: A pavilion roof glows gold among the dark trees of Jingshan, its finial on the skyline, and behind it the city runs to the Western Hills under an afterglow from violet to peach; the White Dagoba stands on the right. The lit roof is the one warm point in a dark, cool frame, and the pine at the right edge gives a near silhouette. The dark hillside at the bottom is heavy, near black with little to read. The other orientation to 4496. Down to 3 on a second pass: the other orientation of 4496, which does it better.
frames.focus: soft in front: dark leaves cross the lit roof; the roof itself acceptable at 100%

frames.technical: Clean sky gradient; the hillside near black at the bottom; noise in the shadows to check
frames.critique: The landscape take: the lit pavilion roof glows in the middle of the dark trees, and the wider frame gives the afterglow its full width, peach at the horizon rising to violet, with the Western Hills in silhouette, the CCTV tower, the White Dagoba at the right, and a pine branch reaching in from the top right. The pine and the roof are the only two shapes near the lens, one black and one gold, and they hold the frame. The bottom third is dark slope. Your 4; the stronger of the pair.

frames.technical: Clean deep sky; the lit roof holds; a CCTV camera on a column; slight noise in the pine
frames.critique: The Wanchun Pavilion from below in landscape, its two upper eaves lit gold and the board on the gable glowing, the dark pine on the left as a silhouette against the deep blue, the red columns and lattice doors warm below. The roof's diagonal climbs from the pine to the top right and the tiers fan out like a hand of cards. Rich, and the pine gives it a near layer the portrait lacks. The bottom edge cuts the columns. The best of the pavilion frames.
frames.focus: sharp (the lit rafters, 100%); a cable crosses

frames.technical: Clean; the glazed base in red and green checks sharp; a person cut at the bottom right corner
frames.critique: The portrait take of the same pavilion corner, with the whole height: the lit upper eaves, the dark lower eave sweeping away to the right in a long curve, the red columns, and the openwork glazed base in red and green checks running out of the frame. The base is a gift, a pattern that echoes the lattice above. The eave's long line into the deep blue is beautiful. Close to 4499; this one is more architecture, that one more night.
frames.focus: sharp (the rafters in shade, 100%); noise in the dark

frames.technical: Low light: noise in the shadows, the floodlit pines warm; the foreground soft and dark
frames.critique: People on benches on Jingshan's slope, each bent over a phone, under pines floodlit gold from below. The light makes the trees a glowing cave and the people small dark shapes inside it, which is a lovely mood, and the panda hood is a nice rhyme with the girls at the lake. But the soft dark branches at the bottom left take a big corner, and the figures are spread across the frame without a group. Mood more than composition. Faces small.
frames.focus: sharp (the man on the bench, 100%); noise

frames.technical: Noise in the dark lower half; the lit board clean; a sign and a masked passer-by at the bottom
frames.critique: The Jifang Pavilion lit from below, its blue board 輯芳亭 centred under the finial and the eaves spreading out, with a soft pine branch hanging in at the top right. The board and finial on the axis give it a strong centre. But the bottom half is the dark doorway with a direction sign and a masked figure, and the soft branch is a smear across the right. 4507 does the roof against the sky far cleaner.

frames.technical: Clean deep sky; low noise; the lit tiers hold; cut at the right edge
frames.critique: The same pavilion, tighter and from the side: the gable with its blue board glows in the middle, the lit eaves step out in two tiers to the left in a long curve, and the left half of the frame is pure deep blue. The empty sky is the space the roof curves into, and the lit colours, green, blue, gold, red, are at their richest against it. The cut at the right edge is the pavilion running on, not a mistake. Close to 4499: a cleaner shape, less night.

frames.technical: The lanterns bright, the cameras sharp; the head at the bottom soft and dark
frames.critique: A lamp post on Jingshan with two lanterns, a red box, a speaker and two CCTV cameras bristling from it, against the afterglow. The juxtaposition of the traditional lantern and the cameras is a point, and the gradient sky is lovely. But the frame is about the idea, the post sits stiffly in the middle, and the soft head at the bottom and the people at the right are clutter. A fun concept, not a strong photo.

frames.technical: The crowd near black with a red-lit face; noise in the shadows; the sky clean
frames.critique: A great tree's branches frame the afterglow over the west, and the White Dagoba glows in the crook of the branches against the Western Hills, with the crowd's dark heads and phones across the bottom third and one girl's face lit red by her screen. The branch-and-dagoba composition is strong and the red face is a striking accent. But the heads fill a third of the frame and the eye goes to the lit phones before the dagoba. 4515 has the branch and the dagoba without the crowd; this one keeps the crowd as its own idea.

frames.technical: The branch soft by design; noise in the dark lower half; sky gradient clean
frames.critique: The White Dagoba glows on the skyline in the afterglow, the Western Hills in silhouette behind it, and a great dark branch reaches in from the top right and ends in a drooping tip that hangs just beside the dagoba, as if pointing to it. The sky runs from peach to violet with small dark clouds scattered through it like punctuation. The lower half is dark trees and roofs with one warm lamp, quiet rather than busy. A calm frame in which the branch and the dagoba hold each other. Your 4.

frames.technical: A red pillar cuts the right edge; the crowd dark with lit screens
frames.critique: The Shenwu Gate lit across the road over a crowd of raised phones, one woman's face lit by her screen at the bottom right. The crowd gives the gate a public, a night out at the palace, which 4524's empty road lacks, and the gate is clean above them. But the red pillar is a hard band at the right edge, and the crowd is dense and dark. A 3; with the pillar cropped it's the better of the two.

frames.technical: Clean black sky; a motion-blurred car at the right edge; the road a dark third
frames.critique: The Shenwu Gate straight on across the road at night, lit gold and red against a black sky, 故宫博物院 on its board, with the floodlit trees at both sides, the railings and walkers in front, and a car streaking past at the right. Symmetrical and well lit, and the street life in front gives it a city's night. But the empty road takes the bottom third, the railings cut across the gate's foot, and the black sky is another third: the gate is a band in the middle. A record of the gate at night.

frames.technical: Low noise in the sky; a street lamp's glare at the top left; the trunk dark
frames.critique: Looking straight up through a ginkgo lit gold from below: the leaves blaze against a deep navy sky, a dark trunk climbs the right edge and a branch reaches across, and the moon sits in a gap in the leaves near the middle. The lit leaves and the moon are the only bright things in a dark frame, warm and cold, and the branches give it lines. The lamp's glare at the top left competes a little. Looking up, at night, in autumn: one of the night's best.
frames.focus: sharp (the lit leaves round the moon, 100%)

frames.technical: Clean deep sky; the moat's reflection has a little noise; a bus parked at the right behind the trees
frames.critique: The Forbidden City's corner tower lit gold over the moat, a canopy of lit leaves hanging from the top with the moon caught in it, and the tower's light breaking in the dark water below. Three layers, leaves, tower, water, each lit warm against the cool night, and the leaves frame the top as the moat frames the bottom. The tower sits small in the middle with the trees round it, and the bus at the right is an odd modern shape behind them. Your 4.

frames.technical: Noise in the sky and water; a bus and a red figure under the wall at the right
frames.critique: The landscape take of the corner tower from the moat's far side, lit leaves hanging from the top, the tower over its trees, the lit wall running off to the right and the moat reflecting it all. The wider frame brings in the side pavilion and the wall's crenellations, but also the parked bus and a car under the wall, and the leaves at the top are two separate clumps rather than a canopy. 4536-2 is the tighter, cleaner frame.

frames.technical: Clean sky, a few stars; the moon with a soft halo; noise low
frames.critique: The corner tower lit gold over its trees and the moat, and high in the empty navy sky at the upper left the moon with a soft halo. The big dark sky is the frame's space, the moon and the tower on a diagonal across it, and the warm tower and its reflection against the cold blue is the night in two colours. The tower is small and the top half empty, which is the point, not the flaw. A different frame from the reflection views: about the night sky over the palace.

frames.technical: Night noise; a streetlight's glare in the middle; the robes sharp
frames.critique: Five women in Qing robes and winged headdresses, embroidered in pale blue and pink with fur trim, walk away from the camera along the moat path under lit trees at night, one turning back with a smile. The robes are beautiful at this distance and their backs make a procession. But the two street lamps blaze right above them, the ordinary walkers at the left share the path, and the group is a cluster rather than a line. The night's echo of 4209; at 100% it's soft everywhere, low light and a slow shutter, so your 2 stands. One face half-turned (stranger).
frames.focus: soft (two more spots: the headdress flower and the robe, 100%): low-light softness and heavy noise

frames.technical: Clean; the reflection with some noise; a dark stone ledge at the bottom right
frames.critique: The corner tower and its pavilion in portrait, the reflection running down, the lit willow at the left. A good frame, but the willow is cropped at the left edge and the stone ledge pokes into the bottom right corner as a dark shape, and the sky over the tower is a heavy black block. 4556 is the same idea, cleaner and symmetric.

frames.technical: Clean; low noise; the reflection holds without banding
frames.critique: The corner tower over the moat at night, centred and symmetrical, lit gold against a navy sky, the lit willow on the left and the autumn trees on the right as two wings, and the tower's reflection running down the dark water in a long broken column. The portrait gives the reflection its length, which is half the picture. Classic, but done with balance and clean light. Your 4.

frames.technical: Clean; low noise; a lamp's streak on the water at the right
frames.critique: The landscape take: the corner tower centred, the willow and the trees spreading wider on both sides, and the reflections of the tower, the willow and a lamp breaking across the whole width of the moat. The lamp's white streak on the right echoes the tower's gold column and gives the water a second rhythm. Wider and calmer than 4556; the portrait has the tower's height, this one the width of the night. Your 4.
